tex_content.label: def:smoothing-bridge
tex_content.html:
Definition
[Compatible smooth model]

For a connected nonempty topological manifold $M$, a compatible smooth model consists of

  1. a manifold $N$ with a topology and an atlas over $E_3$;

  2. a $C^\infty $ manifold structure on $N$;

  3. a Hausdorff, second-countable and compact topology on $N$;

  4. connectedness of $N$; and

  5. a specified homeomorphism $h:M\cong N$.

The smooth atlas must induce this same topology on $N$.

All hypothesis transport and the final composition use this same $h$.
